title: Rabbi Nechemyah bar Ukban
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman cites Jerusalem Talmud Peah, halakhah 5 [compare 1:5], and gives the transmission in this compressed form: “Rabbi Yose bar Yaakov bar Zavdi in Rabbi Abbahu’s name, Rabbi Nechemyah bar Ukban, and it was attributed to Rabbi Yochanan.”

notes.text: The source gives only ה״ה, without a chapter. Its compressed Abbahu/Nechemyah/Yochanan chain is retained without inventing the missing reporting links.

The saved whole Venice Peah1:5 scalar names Rabbi Yose and Rabbi Yaakov bar Zavdi separately, then Rabbi Abbahu, Rabbi Nechemyah bar Ukban and Rabbi Yochanan in a compressed formula. Hyman instead supplies Yose bar Yaakov bar Zavdi as one chain. The literal ה״ה remains beside the matching1:5 comparison. The former chapter5 nonmatch does not exclude this match; no missing reporting link or filiation correction is invented. Full Rabbi titles here are explicit in the named scalar.

The Venice and Guggenheimer editions of Peah 1:5 name Rabbi Yose and Rabbi Yaakov bar Zavdi separately. Venice has Rabbi Nechemyah bar Ukban, while Guggenheimer reads Rabbi Nechemyah bar Mar Ukban. Hyman’s citation gives halakhah 5 without a chapter, and his account leaves several links in the transmission implicit.
